name: ReactION
description: React Component Visualizer for VS Code

viewsWelcome.contents:
Visualize your React app's component tree — right inside VS Code.

$(star-full) Recommended — instantly see your project's component structure from static analysis. No dev server, no browser, no setup:
[$(play) Launch ReactION Static](command:ReactION.openTree)

​        ──────────────        ​

Want real render counts, a wasted-render heatmap, and live DOM highlighting? Connect to your running app (short setup):
[$(rocket) Launch ReactION Live Rendering](command:ReactION.openTreeLive)

​        ──────────────        ​

Need help?
[$(book) Help & Troubleshooting](command:ReactION.showWalkthrough)

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with ReactION
walkthroughs.description: Visualize and profile your React app's live component tree inside VS Code.

steps.title: Launch ReactION Static (recommended)
steps.description:
Instantly see your project's component structure from static analysis — no dev server, no browser, no setup required. Click any node to jump straight to its source.
[Launch ReactION Static](command:ReactION.openTree)

steps.title: Live rendering: start your React app in dev mode
steps.description:
Want real render counts, a wasted-render heatmap, and live DOM highlighting too? ReactION reads a running app through a real Chrome instance, so start your app in development mode first (for example `npm run dev` or `npm start`), then note the URL it serves on.
[Open a Terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new)

steps.title: Live rendering: point ReactION at your dev server
steps.description:
Tell ReactION which URL your app runs on. The setup wizard auto-detects common ports and saves your choice to reactION-config.json.
[Configure Dev Server](command:ReactION.setup)

steps.title: Launch ReactION Live Rendering
steps.description:
Open the interactive graph of your running app, then click any node to inspect its live props, state, and hooks.
[Launch ReactION Live Rendering](command:ReactION.openTreeLive)

steps.title: Troubleshooting & tips
steps.description:
Graph empty, or Chrome won't launch? Here are the common fixes and where to look.
[Show ReactION Log](command:ReactION.showLog)
